name: World of Contracts
tagline: UK jobs board for commercial, contracts and procurement roles
source: Read from the site's own brand file (site/assets/woc.css) and its font folder

colours.name: Treaty navy
colours.role: Main brand colour: headings, links, primary buttons

colours.name: Seal red
colours.role: Accent: the italic 'of', signature line, focus

mono.use: Day rates, reference numbers, small labels

voice: Plain, exact and trustworthy, like a well-drafted contract. No hype. Day rates and facts first.
imagery: Typographic cards with real role data work best.
When people appear, show a mix of nationalities and ethnicities; never one default face.
Brass is for featured roles only, so it keeps its meaning.
logo: Wordmark files are in the site's code: site/brand/woc-wordmark.svg and woc-wordmark-on-dark.svg, with PNG versions for email.
doNot: Do not use brass for ordinary highlights.
Do not put seal red on navy: use coral there.
No pay claims without a source.
toConfirm: Install Fraunces and Inter on the computer you present from (already on the tracker).
The voice line is a first draft written for this sheet. Edit it to sound like you.
